关于这个版本

ZImage Turbo 编辑：

使用此工作流程编辑生成的图像，如 Qwen-Image-Edit无需额外模型或 LoRA。一次提示一项更改，或一次提示所有更改。有无需修补、无需控制网、无需遮蔽- 只需堆叠提示，直到编辑完成。

ZImage Turbo 合并：

生成的图像是使用创建的种子锁定分叉+潜在合并，实施为潜在插值里面一个三级采样器切换:

  • 种子锁定分叉：两个分支都锚定到相同的种子（采样器由相同的种子输入链接驱动）

  • 三阶段采样/即时切换：第 1 阶段创建基础图像，第 2 阶段提前停止（步骤结束）创建附加图像，第 3 阶段继续开始步骤并运行到步骤结束 = 总计创建合并图像。

  • 潜在合并：使用 LatentBlend 和 ModelSampling，根据您的喜好调整合并，以创建使用两个图像中的风格和构图元素的有趣构图。

ZImage Turbo 渲染器：

编辑生成的图像后，将图像发送到渲染器通道以清理图像。最好在发送到 SeedVR2 Upscale 之前使用渲染器通道（可选）。

About this version

ZImage Turbo Edit:

Use this workflow toedit generated images like Qwen-Image-Editwithout additional models or LoRAs. Prompt one change at a time, or all at once. There isNO INPAINTING, NO CONTROLNET, and NO MASKING- simply stack prompts until the edit is complete.

ZImage Turbo Merge:

Generated images are created usingseed-locked bifurcation + latent merge, implemented aslatent interpolationinside athree-stage sampler handoff:

  • Seed-locked bifurcation: both branches are anchored to the same seed (samplers are driven by the same seed input links)

  • Three-stage sampling / prompt handoff: Stage #1 creates the foundational image, Stage #2 stops early (end_at_step) to create the additional image, Stage #3 resumes atstart_at_stepand runs toend_at_step = TOTALto create the merged image.

  • Latent merge: Using LatentBlend and ModelSampling, tune the merge to your taste to create an interesting composition that uses style and composition elements from both images.

ZImage Turbo Renderer:

Once the generated image has been edited, send the image through the Renderer Pass to clean the image. It's best to use the Renderer Pass before sendoff to SeedVR2 Upscale (Optional).
